verdict.rationale: The only policy-related evidence is a passing docs line saying the SOC 2 Launchpad lets you "action policies." That does not document a lawyer-grade template library, a policy editor, versioning, approval workflows, or per-employee acceptance tracking. The GitHub compliance-skills document pack (DPA, ROPA, DPIA and similar) is a separate codebase-scan tool for GDPR documents, not an in-product policy management workflow, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, policies come from a lawyer-grade template library with an editor, versioning, approvals, and per-employee acceptance tracking
